definitionZh: :-moz- only-whitespace CSS 伪类元素匹配只包含文本节点且只包含白空间的元素. (这包括带有空文本节点的元素和没有子节点的元素.
sourceDefinition: The :-moz-only-whitespace CSS pseudo-class matches elements that only contain text nodes that only contain whitespace. (This includes elements with empty text nodes and elements with no child nodes.)
